title: Guwa language
description: Australian Aboriginal language of the Koa people, Queensland
extract: Guwa, also spelt Goa, Koa, and other variants, is an extinct and nearly unattested Australian Aboriginal language of Queensland spoken by the Koa people. It was apparently close to Yanda.
